verdict.rationale: Bevy is a code-first, ECS-driven Rust game engine; the evidence describes programmatic scenes, ECS, rendering, and hot-reload of assets, but there is no mention of a full visual editor with viewport/inspector/prefab GUI tooling as the primary way to build levels. Community comments even suggest users prefer NOT to be forced into an integrated editor (bevy-comm-8), and no editor product is documented.
